newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rosenthal says Wedgwood has 38.6 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Rosenthal says Wedgwood has 38.6 pct stake.

text.p: Irish crystal, china and ceramics group Waterford Wedgwood Plc has built up a 38.6 percent stake in ceramics group Rosenthal AG via the German firm's recent rights issue, Rosenthal said on Friday.
Waterford Wedgwood, which previously owned 9.1 percent of Rosenthal, said in late March that it would sub-underwrite 86.4 percent of a 36-million-mark rights issue at the German firm.

Rosenthal said it had been informed that Waterford Wedgwood's German unit had directly gained voting rights on 25.1 percent of its capital. With the Irish group's additional stake of 13.5 percent, the total holding was 38.6 percent.
The German group, currently in the throes of a restructuring process, said it would make a full statement on this development next week.

Rosenthal reported an operating loss of 4.6 million marks ($2.7 million) in 1996, down from 11.3 million the previous year. It posted a net loss of 48.8 million marks after provisions of some 40 million marks for rationalisation and restructuring costs.
